title: Rory and the Silver Clover Hill
verses:
The twilight was falling across the green hill,
The breeze in the branches was quiet and still.
Then Rory walked out where the silver ferns grow,
And watched the bright fireflies flicker below.

Now Benny walked down to the edge of the pond,
While Ricky peeped out from the bushes beyond.
They rested together beside the cool stream,
Where water was murmuring soft as a dream.

Then Tilly brought leaves that were fragrant and dry,
While Nia flew low in the darkening sky.
She circled down softly through shadows that spread,
To rest on the grass by a velvety bed.

And Psittaco tucked in a pocket of green,
The coziest shelter that ever was seen.
Now Rory lay down where the clover was sweet,
And folded his tail and his sleepy round feet.

The moon drifted up like a lantern so bright,
To bathe all the hill in a calm silver light.
The flowers were nodding in rhythms so slow,
While sweet, sleepy breezes began to blow low.

Now Benny and Tilly let out a soft sigh,
Beneath the cool glow of the starlight on high.
And Rory closed eyes in the hush of the deep,
As all of the dinosaurs drifted to sleep.
